title: A rules-text-only change pays the full quick gate twice…
what: bin/ci:14: MEDIUM: F5 a rules-text-only change pays the full quick gate twice (inert probe): 520 s for 5 lines of markdown
why: Every rule or doc rewording pays an 8.7-minute gate (the inert step runs the quick gate a second time); measured 520 s on a 13-line markdown change, 23 Oct.
failing_case: This change edits 5 lines of rules/structured-data.md. The gate log shows library tests 136 s, hook tests 108 s, inert 267 s
(the inert probe reruns the quick gate in a second worktree): 520 s, about 8.7 min. The tests that can see a rules/*.md edit
(relay_rules parsing, TestStructuredRule, the rule-title tests) run in seconds. Every rule or doc rewording pays the same.
pass_cases: - A change touching only rules/*.md runs the checks that read rules (rule parsing, rule tests, relay sync dry-run) and is green in under a minute.
- A change touching lib/, bin/, plugins/ or hooks still runs the full quick gate and the inert probe.
- A change touching rules/ plus code runs the full gate.
